questions.explanation: Kirchhoff's law of thermal radiation states that for a body of any arbitrary material emitting and absorbing thermal radiation in thermodynamic equilibrium, the emissivity equals its absorptivity.

questions.explanation: The Indian Patent Office head office is in Kolkata, with branch offices located in Mumbai, Chennai, and New Delhi.

questions.question_text: Penalty for the cultivation of any cannabis plant to produce, sell purchase transport in contravention of Narcotic Drugs and Psychotropic substances Act and Rules on first conviction is

questions.question_text: What will be the Heat of vaporisation of $1 \text{ mole}$ of water, when it has the entropy change $(\Delta S)$ of $35.2 \text{ cal/mole.deg}$ (at $25^{\circ}\text{C}$)?
questions.explanation: Using $\Delta H = T \times \Delta S$, where $T = 25 + 273.15 = 298.15 \text{ K}$, $\Delta H = 298.15 \times 35.2 \approx 10495 \text{ cal/mole}$ (closest to option B).

questions.question_text: A mixture of emulsifier A and emulsifier B with values of $4$ and $14$ respectively are to be mixed in a proportion to get mixture with required HLB $12$. What is the weight of individual emulsifier that is to be taken to have a total weight of $7\text{ gm}$?
